# World and effects

Large-scale world building and simulated effects.

## `terrain` { #terrain }

Large heightfield terrain (islands, beaches, mountains, canyons, dunes) with erosion, up to 8 blended material layers and wet shorelines. Rendered with continuous LOD. Use terrain_create, terrain_sculpt, terrain_paint and terrain_layers; heights are relative to the entity.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | string | Project-relative .terrain file with heights and layer weights |  |
| `size` | number | Square extent in meters | 8 .. 32768 |
| `resolution` | integer | Height samples per side (2^n+1: 257, 513, 1025, 2049) |  |
| `generator` | object | Generation parameters (shape, seed, minHeight, maxHeight, featureSize, ridges, warp, erosion, thermal, terraces, beachWidth, seaLevel; shape heightmap: heightmap image, detailNoise) |  |
| `layers` | object[] | Material layers, base first. Each: {name, texture, normalMap, ormMap, color, roughness, tiling (m), heightMin, heightMax, slopeMin, slopeMax, noise, sharpness}. Rules auto-paint the weights. |  |
| `edits` | object[] | Recorded hand edits in terrain-local meters, replayed in order over the generator when the terrain cache is rebuilt: {op: sculpt\|paint\|autopaint, strokes, layer}. Written by terrain_sculpt, terrain_paint and terrain_layers; cleared by terrain_generate. |  |
| `waterLevel` | number | World height of the water line (wet sand/soil just above it) |  |
| `wetBand` | number | Meters above the water line that stay damp | 0 .. 20 |
| `detail` | number | Level-of-detail quality multiplier | 0.25 .. 4 |
| `macroVariation` | number | Large-scale tone and hue variation over the whole landscape (0 = off, 0.5 natural) | 0 .. 1 |
| `castShadows` | boolean | Cast sun shadows |  |
| `overlay` | string | Image draped over the whole terrain (row 0 = -Z edge): political/region maps, borders, paper maps. Alpha masks it; swap it at run time for map modes |  |
| `overlayOpacity` | number | Overlay strength (times the image alpha) | 0 .. 1 |
| `overlayBlend` | string | mix paints over the ground (matte, keeps the relief shading), multiply tints it, glow adds the color unlit (highlights, borders that read at night) | `mix` `multiply` `glow` |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"terrain": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.terrain.data          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `foliage` { #foliage }

GPU-instanced scattering of grass, flowers, ferns, pebbles, shells, rocks and trees over a terrain (this entity or its parent) or over scene meshes inside `area`. Wind-animated, deterministic. Use foliage_add with presets.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layers` | object[] | Layers: [{preset, mesh \| prefab, color, density (/m²), scaleMin, scaleMax, slopeMin, slopeMax, heightMin, heightMax, terrainLayer, wind, cullDistance, castShadows, clumping, alignToNormal, impostors, impostorDistance, impostorResolution, impostorFrames}]. Distant instances of heavy meshes draw as octahedral impostors (see impostor_bake). |  |
| `seed` | integer | Random seed of the placement |  |
| `density` | number | Density multiplier for every layer | 0 .. 4 |
| `surface` | string | What to grow on | `terrain` `scene` |
| `area` | number[3] | Scene mode: extent in meters around the entity |  |
| `visible` | boolean | Draw the foliage |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"foliage": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.foliage.layers          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `water` { #water }

Water surface with a spectral (FFT) ocean simulation: wind waves, choppy crests, foam, refraction, depth color and reflections. Entity y = water level. Query wave heights with water_query / Wander water_height().

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `windSpeed` | number | Wind speed (m/s): 2 calm lake, 8 breezy sea, 18 storm | 0 .. 40 |
| `windDirection` | number | Direction the waves travel (degrees, 0 = +Z) |  |
| `choppiness` | number | Sharpness of crests (0 = rolling swell) | 0 .. 3 |
| `waveScale` | number | Wave amplitude multiplier | 0 .. 5 |
| `patchSize` | number | Longest simulated wavelength (m) | 10 .. 2000 |
| `size` | number | Square extent in meters (0 = endless ocean) | 0 .. 100000 |
| `depth` | number | Water depth for wave physics (shallow water slows waves) | 0.5 .. 5000 |
| `deepColor` | color | Light scattered inside deep water — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `shallowColor` | color | Tint of what you see through shallow water — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `clarity` | number | How far you can see into the water (m) | 0.1 .. 100 |
| `foam` | number | Whitecaps and shoreline foam | 0 .. 4 |
| `reflections` | number | Reflection strength | 0 .. 2 |
| `refraction` | number | Refraction distortion | 0 .. 4 |
| `roughness` | number | Micro roughness (sun glint size) | 0.005 .. 0.5 |
| `seed` | integer | Random seed of the wave field |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"water": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.water.windSpeed          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `particles` { #particles }

Particle emitter: fire, smoke, embers, sparks, rain, snow, mist, magic. Simulated by the engine and drawn as soft HDR particles. Easiest start: fx_create with a preset, then tweak fields.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | string | Preset it was made from (informational) |  |
| `emitting` | boolean | Emit new particles (existing ones finish their life) |  |
| `look` | string | glow = soft light points; flame = animated fire tongues; smoke = lit billowing volume; spark = glowing streaks; rain = lit falling streaks; snow = soft flakes; mist = drifting fog; sprite = textured / flipbook sheet (`texture`, gpu only) | `glow` `flame` `smoke` `spark` `rain` `snow` `mist` `sprite` |
| `rate` | number | Particles per second | 0 .. 4000000 |
| `burst` | integer | Particles emitted at once when it starts (explosions); Wander burst(n) emits more |  |
| `maxParticles` | integer | Upper bound of live particles (cpu: up to 50000; gpu: up to 4000000) |  |
| `lifetime` | number | Seconds each particle lives | 0.01 .. 120 |
| `lifetimeJitter` | number | Random lifetime variation (fraction) | 0 .. 1 |
| `shape` | string | Where particles are born (scaled by shapeSize) | `point` `sphere` `box` `disc` `cone` |
| `shapeSize` | number[3] | Size of the emission shape (m) |  |
| `direction` | number[3] | Emission direction in the entity's space |  |
| `speed` | number | Initial speed (m/s) | 0 .. 500 |
| `speedJitter` | number | Random speed variation (fraction) | 0 .. 1 |
| `spread` | number | Cone half-angle around direction (degrees) | 0 .. 180 |
| `gravity` | number | Downward acceleration (m/s^2); negative = rises like hot gas | -50 .. 50 |
| `drag` | number | Air resistance (per second) | 0 .. 20 |
| `turbulence` | number | Curl-noise swirl strength (m/s) | 0 .. 50 |
| `turbulenceScale` | number | Swirl size (m) | 0.01 .. 100 |
| `wind` | number | How strongly the environment wind carries particles | 0 .. 5 |
| `sizeStart` | number | Size at birth (m) | 0 .. 100 |
| `sizeEnd` | number | Size at death (m) | 0 .. 100 |
| `sizeJitter` | number | Random size variation (fraction) | 0 .. 1 |
| `colorStart` | color | Color at birth (alpha = opacity) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `colorEnd` | color | Color at death (alpha = opacity) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `intensity` | number | HDR brightness (glows with bloom above ~1) | 0 .. 200 |
| `stretch` | number | Streak length along velocity (seconds of motion) | 0 .. 1 |
| `spin` | number | Random rotation speed (degrees/s) | 0 .. 1440 |
| `softness` | number | Fade where particles meet geometry (m) | 0 .. 10 |
| `worldSpace` | boolean | Particles stay behind when the emitter moves (trails) |  |
| `collide` | boolean | Collide with the floor plane at floorHeight |  |
| `floorHeight` | number | World height of the collision floor |  |
| `bounce` | number | Bounciness on impact (0 = die) | 0 .. 1 |
| `splash` | integer | Droplets spawned per impact (rain splashes) |  |
| `light` | number | Light cast on the scene (flickers with the particles) | 0 .. 100 |
| `lightColor` | color | Color of the cast light — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `lightRange` | number | Reach of the cast light (m) | 0.1 .. 200 |
| `prewarm` | boolean | Start fully developed instead of from nothing |  |
| `seed` | integer | Random seed (variations of the same effect) |  |
| `simulation` | string | cpu = deterministic engine simulation (gameplay, countable); gpu = compute shaders, millions of particles, depth collisions, sub-emitters, ribbons, mesh particles (visuals only) | `cpu` `gpu` |
| `facing` | string | gpu: camera = billboards; velocity = stretched along motion (`stretch`); horizontal = flat on the ground plane (ripples, decals); ribbon = trails (`trailLength`); mesh = instanced lit meshes (`mesh`) | `camera` `velocity` `horizontal` `ribbon` `mesh` |
| `mesh` | string | gpu facing mesh: primitive (cube, sphere...), "asset:&lt;path&gt;", or built-in fx:leaf, fx:shard, fx:pebble |  |
| `roughness` | number | gpu mesh particles: surface roughness | 0.02 .. 1 |
| `metallic` | number | gpu mesh particles: metalness | 0 .. 1 |
| `texture` | string | gpu look sprite: sprite or flipbook sheet (png/jpg), project-relative |  |
| `flipbookColumns` | integer | Flipbook sheet columns |  |
| `flipbookRows` | integer | Flipbook sheet rows |  |
| `flipbookFps` | number | Flipbook frames per second (0 = once over each life; frames cross-fade) | 0 .. 240 |
| `colorGradient` | string | gpu: color over life, e.g. "#fff6d0@0 #ffa030@0.2 #a01800@0.7 #20000000@1" (overrides colorStart/End) |  |
| `sizeCurve` | string | gpu: size multiplier over life, e.g. "0@0 1@0.1 0.3@1" |  |
| `opacityCurve` | string | gpu: opacity multiplier over life, e.g. "0@0 1@0.2 0@1" |  |
| `shapeMesh` | string | gpu shape mesh: emit from this mesh's surface ("" = this entity's mesh) |  |
| `field` | string | gpu force field: vortex = swirl around fieldAxis (tornado, magic); attractor = pull toward fieldCenter; texture = vector field from fieldTexture (.fga) | `none` `vortex` `attractor` `texture` |
| `fieldStrength` | number | Force field strength (m/s; attractor m/s^2) | -1000 .. 1000 |
| `fieldRadius` | number | Force field radius (m) | 0.01 .. 1000 |
| `fieldCenter` | number[3] | Force field center (local offset) |  |
| `fieldAxis` | number[3] | Vortex axis (local) |  |
| `fieldPull` | number | Vortex inward pull (m/s) | -100 .. 100 |
| `fieldLift` | number | Vortex lift along its axis (m/s) | -100 .. 100 |
| `fieldTexture` | string | Vector field file (.fga from Houdini or EmberGen) |  |
| `fieldSize` | number[3] | Box covered by the vector field (m, centered on fieldCenter) |  |
| `depthCollision` | boolean | gpu: collide with everything visible on screen (scene depth + normals): sparks bouncing off props, rain splashing on roofs |  |
| `stick` | boolean | gpu: particles stick where they collide (paint, snow, blood) |  |
| `friction` | number | gpu: tangential slow-down on bounce | 0 .. 1 |
| `colliders` | string | gpu: comma-separated entity names: sphere meshes collide as spheres, planes/quads as planes, other meshes as bounding spheres |  |
| `subEmitter` | string | gpu: name of another gpu particles entity spawned where these particles die/hit (sparks -&gt; embers, rockets -&gt; fireworks) |  |
| `subEmitOn` | string | When sub-emitter particles spawn | `death` `collision` `both` |
| `subEmitCount` | integer | Sub-emitter particles per event |  |
| `subEmitInherit` | number | Fraction of the parent's velocity inherited | 0 .. 2 |
| `trailLength` | number | Ribbon trail length (seconds of history) | 0.01 .. 10 |
| `trailSegments` | integer | Ribbon history samples |  |
| `sort` | boolean | gpu blended looks: sort back to front on the GPU (off = faster) |  |
| `hueVariation` | number | gpu: random hue rotation per particle; sub-emitted particles share their event's hue (fireworks) | 0 .. 1 |

## `fluid` { #fluid }

Volumetric fluid simulation for fire, smoke, steam and explosions (GPU 3D solver, ray-marched): fuel burns into heat and soot, hot gas rises and swirls. The box sits on the entity (bottom center). Start with fx_create (volume_fire, volume_smoke, steam_vent, explosion_volume...).

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | string | Preset it was made from (informational) |  |
| `emitting` | boolean | Feed the source (off: the fire dies down) |  |
| `size` | number[3] | Simulation box in meters (fire lives inside it) |  |
| `resolution` | integer | Cells along the longest side (detail vs. cost) |  |
| `sourceOffset` | number[3] | Source position from the box's bottom center (m) |  |
| `sourceRadius` | number | Source radius (m) | 0.01 .. 50 |
| `fuel` | number | Fuel fed per second (0 = smoke/steam only) | 0 .. 20 |
| `heat` | number | Heat released (drives flames and lift) | 0 .. 20 |
| `smoke` | number | Soot / vapour produced | 0 .. 20 |
| `buoyancy` | number | How fast hot gas rises | 0 .. 20 |
| `vorticity` | number | Swirl: licking flames, curling smoke | 0 .. 5 |
| `turbulence` | number | Noise injected at the source | 0 .. 5 |
| `burnRate` | number | How fast fuel burns (lower = taller flames) | 0.05 .. 20 |
| `cooling` | number | How fast heat fades | 0 .. 20 |
| `smokeFade` | number | How fast smoke thins out | 0 .. 20 |
| `speed` | number | Upward speed at the source (m/s) | 0 .. 50 |
| `wind` | number | Environment wind influence | 0 .. 5 |
| `flameIntensity` | number | Fire brightness | 0 .. 50 |
| `flameTemperature` | number | Flame color temperature in Kelvin (blackbody) | 800 .. 6000 |
| `smokeColor` | color | Smoke albedo (dark soot .. white steam) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `smokeDensity` | number | Smoke opacity | 0 .. 20 |
| `light` | number | Light the fire casts on the scene | 0 .. 200 |
| `lightColor` | color | Color of the cast light — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `lightRange` | number | Reach of the cast light (m) | 0.1 .. 300 |
| `burst` | number | Seconds of heavy fuel at start (explosions, fireballs) | 0 .. 10 |
| `seed` | integer | Random seed (variation) |  |


## `groom` { #groom }

Strand hair and fur grown on the entity's mesh (or `target`'s), or loaded from a .hair/.groom.json/.skygroom file. Rendered as real strands (Marschner shading, deep opacity self-shadowing, multiple scattering) and simulated on the GPU (gravity, wind, collisions). Easiest start: groom_create with a preset (hair_straight, hair_wavy, hair_curly, hair_ponytail, hair_short, fur_short, fur_long), then tweak fields.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | string | Preset it was made from (informational) |  |
| `visible` | boolean | Draw the groom |  |
| `source` | string | Groom file (.hair = Cem Yuksel's format, .groom.json, .skygroom), project-relative; "" = grow procedurally on the mesh |  |
| `target` | string | Entity whose mesh grows the hair ("" = this entity) |  |
| `importScale` | number | Imported files: scale to meters (0.01 for centimeters) | 1e-05 .. 1000 |
| `importZUp` | boolean | Imported files: the source is Z-up |  |
| `strands` | integer | Rendered strands (head of hair 50k-150k; fur 100k+). Imported files: cap |  |
| `guides` | integer | Simulated guide strands (0 = automatic, ~4*sqrt(strands)) |  |
| `segments` | integer | Segments per strand (smoothness of curls; 4 for fur, 16-31 for long hair) |  |
| `length` | number | Strand length in meters | 0.001 .. 5 |
| `lengthVariation` | number | Random length variation (fraction) | 0 .. 0.95 |
| `widthRoot` | number | Strand width at the root in millimeters (human hair 0.05-0.1) | 0.001 .. 10 |
| `widthTip` | number | Strand width at the tip in millimeters | 0 .. 10 |
| `direction` | number[3] | Comb direction in the mesh's space (e.g. [0,-1,-0.4] = down and back) |  |
| `directionBlend` | number | 0 = grow along the surface normal, 1 = along `direction` | 0 .. 1 |
| `gravity` | number | Droop: 0 = stands up (fur, crew cut) .. 1 = hangs down | 0 .. 2 |
| `curlRadius` | number | Curl (helix) radius in meters (0.005-0.02 for curly hair) | 0 .. 0.2 |
| `curlFrequency` | number | Curl turns per meter of strand | 0 .. 200 |
| `wave` | number | Wave amplitude in meters | 0 .. 0.2 |
| `waveFrequency` | number | Waves per meter of strand | 0 .. 100 |
| `clumps` | integer | Clumps strands gather into (0 = none; hundreds for a head) |  |
| `clumpStrength` | number | How far strands pull into their clump | 0 .. 1 |
| `clumpShape` | number | Clump profile: &gt; 1 tips clump more than roots, &lt; 1 clump early | 0.1 .. 8 |
| `frizz` | number | Noise / flyaways in meters | 0 .. 0.1 |
| `frizzScale` | number | Frizz noise frequency (per meter) | 0.1 .. 1000 |
| `ponytail` | boolean | Comb every strand to ponytailPosition, then let them hang as one bundle |  |
| `ponytailPosition` | number[3] | Where the ponytail is tied (mesh space, meters; just outside the scalp) |  |
| `maskChannel` | string | Vertex-color channel that controls density (scalp painting) | `none` `r` `g` `b` `a` |
| `maskDirection` | number[3] | Grow only where the surface faces this way (mesh space; with maskAngle) |  |
| `maskAngle` | number | Degrees around maskDirection that grow hair (180 = everywhere) | 0 .. 180 |
| `maskSoftness` | number | Soft hairline width in degrees | 0 .. 90 |
| `melanin` | number | Pigment (physically based absorption): 0 white, 0.1 platinum, 0.2 blond, 0.35 dark blond, 0.5 light brown, 0.7 brown, 0.85 dark brown, 0.95+ black | 0 .. 1 |
| `redness` | number | Red pigment (pheomelanin) fraction: 0.5 auburn, 0.9 ginger | 0 .. 1 |
| `dye` | color | Dye tint (white = natural) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `rootColor` | color | Color multiplier at the roots (root-to-tip gradient, e.g. dark roots) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `tipColor` | color | Color multiplier at the tips (sun-bleached or dyed tips) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `colorVariation` | number | Per-strand pigment variation | 0 .. 1 |
| `roughness` | number | Longitudinal roughness: highlight width (0.2 silky .. 0.6 dull) | 0.02 .. 1 |
| `radialRoughness` | number | Azimuthal roughness: softness of light through the strand | 0.05 .. 1 |
| `specular` | number | Primary (white) highlight strength | 0 .. 4 |
| `scatter` | number | Multiple scattering: light hair glows, dark hair stays rich | 0 .. 4 |
| `cuticleTilt` | number | Cuticle tilt in degrees (separates the two highlights) | 0 .. 10 |
| `density` | number | Coverage per strand (2 = a full head of hair at typical strand counts; lower for wispy, higher for thick) | 0.05 .. 8 |
| `simulate` | boolean | Simulate on the GPU (gravity, wind, collisions) |  |
| `stiffness` | number | How strongly strands keep their groomed shape | 0 .. 1 |
| `rootStiffness` | number | Stiffness near the roots | 0 .. 1 |
| `damping` | number | Velocity damping | 0 .. 1 |
| `wind` | number | Environment wind influence | 0 .. 10 |
| `collide` | boolean | Collide with the mesh (sphere/capsule proxy) and `colliders` |  |
| `colliders` | string | Comma-separated entity names that hair collides with (shoulders, hands) |  |
| `lod` | string | auto = strands up close, cards far away; strands; cards (cheapest) | `auto` `strands` `cards` |
| `cardsBelow` | number | auto LOD: draw cards when the groom is smaller than this (pixels) | 0 .. 4096 |
| `castShadows` | boolean | Cast sun shadows on the scene |  |
| `seed` | integer | Random seed (a different head of the same style) |  |

=== "Tool call"


=== "Wander"

